analysis_notes.summary: Torah #112 is a very short aphorism: 'If you believe you can damage, believe you can repair.' It contains no bechina (parallel-aspect) language whatsoever. The key concepts — אֱמוּנָה (belief), קִלְקוּל (damage), תִּקּוּן (repair), הִתְחַזְּקוּת (strengthening) — are presented in a cause-and-effect/advisory (eitza) framework, not as parallel aspects of the same essence. Therefore no bechina edges exist and no packages can be formed.
